newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials open higher, overall stocks mixed.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials open higher, overall stocks mixed.

text.p: The Dow Industrials index moved higher in early trading, bolstered by on-target September consumer inflation data that gave some strength to bonds.
Overall, stocks were mixed as the market continued to digest its recent gains.
The Dow industrials was up six at 6,011, the NASDAQ Index was down two at 1,256, while the S&P Index fell fractionally to 702.
The 30-year long bond was up 6/32 to yield 6.83 percent.
